nodes.label: Product Capability
nodes.plain_language: What useful outcome one Product must make possible.
nodes.claim: Product Capability is private product meaning and remains distinct from every realization.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 definitions-governance owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not Agent Capability, Product, Project, Goal, Context, implementation, interface, command, permission, evidence, or authority.

nodes.label: Agent Capability
nodes.plain_language: A reusable job an agent can do under an owned contract.
nodes.claim: Agent Capability meaning remains public Arcanum authority and is referenced, not redefined, here.
nodes.owner_route: Arcanum definitions-governance owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not Product Capability, prompt, model, command, installation, process, run, permission, or private product meaning.

nodes.label: Capability Reference
nodes.plain_language: A typed pointer to a source-owned Product or Agent Capability.
nodes.claim: The package owns the reference grammar, never the referenced instance.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 capability owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a generic Capability definition, instance copy, adoption, realization, conformance, ownership transfer, or authority grant.

nodes.label: Capability Lifecycle Posture
nodes.plain_language: Separate status, evidence, commitment, provenance, owner, and residue, using the source's own status vocabulary.
nodes.claim: Capability references preserve orthogonal lifecycle axes and separate realization and conformance postures.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 definitions-governance owner plus each capability lifecycle owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not one universal lifecycle enum and not permission to infer one axis from another.

nodes.label: CyberAlchemy

nodes.claim: This is a source-bound Product projection and does not define Product canonically.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not Product Capability, product proof, release, or runtime.
